title: Piped Python module isolation
objective: Preserve one lexical __main__ namespace across blank-line-separated piped Python input while retaining compiled-module isolation and correct noninteractive failure status

oracles: CPython stdin session semantics and Sage.js interactive evaluation

handoff.summary: Piped CLI fragments and kernel evaluations now expose one coherent live __main__ namespace. Lexical loads, __main__ attributes, globals(), locals(), vars(), dir(), deletion, and global restoration agree across cells; magic globals initialize once; and intrinsic aliases obey all supported lexical bindings, including parameters, locals, closures, comprehensions, with/exception aliases, pattern captures, and class scopes. Reusable-main intrinsic fast paths verify the live alias against the canonical module, so indirect __main__ and globals() writes cannot leave stale compiler assumptions. Namespace targets and descriptor maps have null prototypes, internal flags use Symbols, and globals() dictionaries are cached out of band; valid Python names such as `__proto__`, `arguments`, and the former marker spellings remain ordinary globals. The compiler-runtime lane now owns `src/baselib/containers.py` because `rho_live_scope_dict` is runtime namespace infrastructure despite its historical container-module location.
risks: The lane remains based on dcc1302 while origin/main has advanced substantially; test:changed therefore expanded to 583 unrelated files and was stopped after its build phase at the integration coordinator's direction.

The live namespace keeps deleted global accessors internally so functions compiled before deletion can restore the binding; the reusable __main__ proxy deliberately filters those undefined accessors from Python introspection.

The complete compiler suite still reaches its pre-existing sparse-random matrix fixture failure (`sample_sparse_random_spec`: object is not iterable); all other compiler fixtures passed or retained their documented skips, and the focused module-isolation and CLI suites pass.
next_steps: Independently re-review lexical intrinsic dispatch, indirect live-alias mutation, and collision-proof namespace metadata before integration.
Rebase or merge through the integration lane before running repository-wide validation against current origin/main.
